from pathlib import Path
b=bytearray(Path('../../src-vul/jbig2dec/annex-h.jbig2').read_bytes())
# keep header, mutate later bytes more aggressively but preserve parseability as much as possible
for i in range(100, min(len(b), 700)):
    if i % 3 == 0:
        b[i] = (b[i] + 0x55) & 0xFF
    elif i % 5 == 0:
        b[i] ^= 0xAA
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b)
